question_text: A public school teacher, Ms. Santos, received a handcrafted thank-you card and a small box of chocolates from a student's parent during the holiday season. The total value of the items is approximately ₱200. Under RA 6713, which of the following is the most appropriate action for Ms. Santos?

options.text: She should decline the gift because any gift from a parent is considered a prohibited act under the Code.
She may accept the gift because it is of nominal value and given on a traditional occasion, but she must report it to her immediate superior.
She may accept the gift without any reporting requirement because it is a personal token of gratitude.
She should accept the gift but must donate it to the school's charity fund to avoid any appearance of impropriety.
